item.subject: science
item.stem:
Vihaan has a white cotton shirt and a black cotton shirt of the same thickness. He packs for a cold early-morning walk and for a hot sunny cricket match later the same day.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: For the hot sunny match he should wear the white shirt because light colours reflect most of the heat; for the cold morning walk the black shirt absorbs more heat.
options.B: For the hot sunny match he should wear the black shirt; for the cold morning walk he should wear the white shirt.
options.C: Even with no heat falling on either shirt, the black shirt gains more heat.
options.D: The black cotton shirt traps body heat better than the white cotton shirt because dark colour is a better insulator.
